source:
@@U00426@@
I curse the purple juice of the grape! I curse the transcendent flight of love! Curse hope, curse faith, and above all else curse patience!

@@U00428@@
Autti! Ait! You have destroyed The beautiful world With a merciless blow! It totters, it crumbles, It shatters, it tumbles, A demigod has dashed it. The ruins we trail Back into Nothingness, Ah, and wail The loss of beauty. Mightiest of men, Of the sons of earth, Build it again, Give it new birth, Raise it more splendidly In your own breast! Begin again! Begin! A new life! A life of cheer! A life of new vision, With a mind that is clear! And new songs To welcome it in!

@@U00430@@
These are mine, these little minions. Notice how sagely they urge you on to pleasure, urge you on to action! They long to lure you into the wide world, to abandon your solitary life where sense and sap stagnate and stand still.
translation:
@@U00426@@
我诅咒葡萄汁是紫色的！我诅咒爱情的超凡飞翔！诅咒希望，诅咒信仰，最重要的是诅咒耐心！

@@U00428@@
奥蒂！哎呀！你用无情的一击摧毁了美丽的世界！它摇摇欲坠，它崩溃，它破碎，它翻滚，一个半神已经粉碎了它。我们追踪的废墟回到虚无，啊，并哀叹美丽的丧失。大地之子中最强大的人，再次建造它，赋予它新生，在你自己的胸中将它养育得更加辉煌！重新开始！开始！新的生活！生活充满欢乐！人生新视野，心清明！还有新歌来迎接它的到来！

@@U00430@@
这些是我的，这些小爪牙。请注意，他们是多么明智地敦促您享受快乐，敦促您采取行动！他们渴望引诱你进入广阔的世界，放弃你的感觉和元气停滞不前的孤独生活。
